statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The NDC reports recent floods in KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern and Western Cape; Northern Cape/interior heatwaves; droughts in Eastern Cape, Western Cape and Free State; Gauteng storms and Western Cape wildfires. Poor communities suffered most; businesses and municipalities struggled to recover.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The NDC reports recent floods in KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern and Western Cape; Northern Cape/interior heatwaves; droughts in Eastern Cape, Western Cape and Free State; Gauteng storms and Western Cape wildfires. Poor communities suffered most; businesses and municipalities struggled to recover.

source_refs.locator: NDC printed pp. 5-6, section 2(c), 'Climate impacts experienced in South Africa'.

statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The NDC identifies high household climate vulnerability in KwaZulu-Natal, North West, Limpopo and Eastern Cape; eastern Eastern Cape municipalities are more vulnerable. Unsafe water/toilet access and food poverty are prominent.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The NDC identifies high household climate vulnerability in KwaZulu-Natal, North West, Limpopo and Eastern Cape; eastern Eastern Cape municipalities are more vulnerable. Unsafe water/toilet access and food poverty are prominent.
affected_groups: households with unsafe water or toilet access

source_refs.locator: NDC printed pp. 5-6, section 2(c), household-level vulnerability discussion.

statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The 2024 Climate Change Act establishes recurring climate-risk and vulnerability assessments, adaptation planning and reporting for national, provincial and municipal government and identified sectors.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The 2024 Climate Change Act establishes recurring climate-risk and vulnerability assessments, adaptation planning and reporting for national, provincial and municipal government and identified sectors.

source_refs.locator: NDC printed p. 7, section 3(a), adaptation strategy and planning arrangements.

statement: The 2025 NDC sets proposed 2031-2035 priorities for disaster, health, sanitation, emergency accommodation and care support, including informal settlements and marginalized flood-displaced groups. These are policy commitments, not delivered services.
compact_statement: The 2025 NDC sets proposed 2031-2035 priorities for disaster, health, sanitation, emergency accommodation and care support, including informal settlements and marginalized flood-displaced groups. These are policy commitments, not delivered services.

source_refs.locator: NDC printed p. 10, Table 1, adaptation Goal 2 and priority interventions for 2031-2035.

uncertainty: Proposal only; no municipality or delivery outcome is named.

statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: Workshop synthesis says climate risks were not perceived among municipalities' top ten priorities, making climate response difficult to prioritize amid pressing governance issues.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: Workshop synthesis says climate risks were not perceived among municipalities' top ten priorities, making climate response difficult to prioritize amid pressing governance issues.

source_refs.locator: Workshop report printed p. 9, section 2.3, 'Key workshop outcomes'.

uncertainty: Workshop synthesis, not a representative survey.

statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: A sector report presented to participants identified water and land stress as compounding climate impacts for smallholder and household producers reliant on rainfall, marginal land, inputs and finance.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: A sector report presented to participants identified water and land stress as compounding climate impacts for smallholder and household producers reliant on rainfall, marginal land, inputs and finance.

source_refs.locator: Workshop report printed p. 13, 'Key issues facing agriculture in dealing with climate change'.

uncertainty: Workshop relays a sector report, not a farmer survey.

statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: The built-environment presentation says informal settlements and systems fall outside formal controls intended to protect people from hazards such as floodlines; poorer, more vulnerable communities live in these areas.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: The built-environment presentation says informal settlements and systems fall outside formal controls intended to protect people from hazards such as floodlines; poorer, more vulnerable communities live in these areas.

source_refs.locator: Workshop report printed pp. 24-25, built-environment synthesis presentation.

statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: Participants highlighted community-based organizations for their direct local interface and knowledge of realities facing poorer and more vulnerable people as potential adaptation-readiness partners.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: Participants highlighted community-based organizations for their direct local interface and knowledge of realities facing poorer and more vulnerable people as potential adaptation-readiness partners.

source_refs.locator: Workshop report printed p. 36, delivery-capacity group discussion summary.

statement: Source dated 2023-07 reports: De Doorns and Touwsrivier score very high socioeconomic vulnerability; Touwsrivier also ranks worst for Breede Valley connectivity.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023-07 reports: De Doorns and Touwsrivier score very high socioeconomic vulnerability; Touwsrivier also ranks worst for Breede Valley connectivity.

statement: Source dated 2023-07 reports: Under RCP 8.5, increased future flood risk is projected for Paarl, Stellenbosch, De Doorns, Touwsrivier and Montagu.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023-07 reports: Under RCP 8.5, increased future flood risk is projected for Paarl, Stellenbosch, De Doorns, Touwsrivier and Montagu.

statement: Source dated 2023-07 reports: The profile's 2017-based table gives Witzenberg demand of 146.71 litres per capita daily against 144.23 supply, with a vulnerability score of 1.02.

statement: Source dated 2023-07 reports: Witzenberg's water vulnerability score is projected to rise to 1.7 by 2050 with population pressure, declining rainfall and runoff, and increased evaporation.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023-07 reports: Witzenberg's water vulnerability score is projected to rise to 1.7 by 2050 with population pressure, declining rainfall and runoff, and increased evaporation.
scenario: Emissions pathway unspecified in cited projection.

statement: A study of monthly weather and police records for 1,158 South African police wards in 2001-2012 reports warmer-month associations with violent crime and modest rural property-taking responses to growing-season drought, not urban crime. Effects are subtle, mediation is unidentified and weather findings do not establish anthropogenic climate attribution.
compact_statement: A study of monthly weather and police records for 1,158 South African police wards in 2001-2012 reports warmer-month associations with violent crime and modest rural property-taking responses to growing-season drought, not urban crime. Effects are subtle, mediation is unidentified and weather findings do not establish anthropogenic climate attribution.
uncertainty: This is weather, not anthropogenic climate attribution; effects are subtle, mechanisms are not identified, and monthly data miss within-month timing.
